About ACCTA

A member-focused, public-interest professional body.

The Association of Certified Chartered Tax Advisors sets professional and ethical standards for tax advisory practice, awards the Certified Chartered Tax Advisor (CCTA) qualification, and supports members through continuing professional development, research and advocacy.

We work with government, regulators, academic institutions and international professional bodies to support transparent, fair and efficient tax systems.

Read more about ACCTA →

Vision

To be a globally respected institute advancing excellence and integrity in tax advisory.

Mission

To develop competent, ethical, and globally recognised tax advisors while safeguarding the public interest.

IntegrityExcellenceIndependenceAccountabilityTransparencyPublic InterestInnovationCollaboration

ACTA

Fellow (Standard)

FCTA

Associate for 5 years + senior experience + CPD; or qualifications accepted for Fellowship

Associate Academic

AACTA

Degree in a related field + 3 years of teaching and research experience in taxation

Fellow Academic

FACTA

Corporate Member

—

Experienced, but without the formal qualification?

Mature entry is open for Standard Membership: 15 years' taxation experience for Associate, or 25 years including 10 in a senior role for Fellow.

About mature entry

The CCTA Qualification

Four levels. On-demand, computer-based exams.

Built on a taxation competency framework and designed to be compatible with SLQF Level 6. Sit exams at any time of the year.

International

Chapters overseas
